scope: Five-hour curriculum improvement review across all six phases, emphasizing robotics, AI and independent learning. Checks below have different scopes and are not interchangeable.

portable_checks.optional_environment_note: TVM suite wholly skipped in baseline, separately executed in pinned environment; optional lab manifests record additional framework/native executions. Do not sum overlapping runs as unique tests.

static_source_checks.syntax_scope: Parsing only, not execution of every example or external command
static_source_checks.hash_scope: Unresolved keys include temporary/external/upstream paths and are not counted as verified local files.

checks: Mermaid diagrams rendered without syntax errors
all_source_pages_mobile.math_note: Full formula completion checked separately below.

run_settings.network_policy: GitHub repository metadata API requests blocked; course assets and fonts loaded normally

selected_pages.scope: Learner entry pages, new lab pages, advanced RL equations, embedded plots and diagrams.

math.network_policy: All HTTP requests except127.0.0.1:8765 blocked; entire math loader,fonts,and accessibility from local site

navigation.scroll_boundary: Viewport containment; content may extend into prose margins
navigation.accessibility_scope: Representative keyboard navigation, computed colors and MathML accessibility-tree preservation; not a full screen-reader or WCAG certification.

browser_checks.environment: Local Google Chrome through Playwright; desktop and mobile viewport emulation, not physical touch devices.

final_overview_revisions.scope: README, role-selection guide and revised GPU/inference overview pages

full_suite_snapshot.working_directory: Unrelated directory; archive and cwd paths contain spaces

final_docs_and_tooling_snapshot.note: Latest public inventory/summary/report metadata may postdate this immutable archive. Full749 suite was not repeated in this second archive; final workspace run is recorded above.

external_route_links.scope: Primary-source links from entry and new robotics/AI labs only; HTTP reachability, not external fragment validation or a full-site external-link crawl.

limitations: No hosted deployment or hosted CI run is claimed.
GPU/model-scale benchmarks, Isaac simulator scenes and training, FPGA board timing, Jetson deployment, physical robots and custom silicon need their named equipment/environments.
CPU arithmetic, actual CPU execution, target compilation, simulation and measurements on hardware are distinguished in each lab.
A curriculum-wide structure/entry review and targeted technical revisions do not certify every historical statement or external command.
